title: Browse with AI
description: Use AI agent to browse websites and perform complex multi-step tasks. Navigate pages, fill forms, create accounts, click buttons, handle multi-page flows. The agent can handle tasks like: 'Go to https://accounts.google.com/signup and create an account with first name Taro, last name Yamada, username taro.test.2026, password Str0ngP@ss!'

arguments.task: Open https://example.com and report the page title

examples.user: サイトを見て内容を確認して

arguments.task: Open the requested site and summarize the visible content

task.description: Detailed task description including URL and what to do. For complex tasks like account creation, include all required details (name, username, password, etc.). Example: 'Go to https://accounts.google.com/signup and create account with first name Taro, last name Yamada, username taro.test.2026, password Str0ngP@ss!'

max_steps.description: Maximum number of steps the agent can take (default: 50). Increase for complex multi-page flows.
